name: The Herald's Landing
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from keepers-hall. Theme and props from the storm-stair draft room "heralds-landing". A wide windy platform in the clouds; the Storm Herald stands tall in the middle with ribbons of wind.
signs: A bell rings from the top.
